mcp.note: GitHub Pages cannot run a POST MCP server. In production, POST this endpoint with JSON-RPC initialize, then tools/list, then tools/call. This file lists the tools the live endpoint would expose.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: List all products with price and stock.

tools.name: recommend_products
tools.description: Recommend 1 first choice + 1 alternative based on use, preference and budget. Read guide.md / recommendations.json first.

tools.name: calculate_total
tools.description: Calculate price x quantity + shipping, and whether free shipping over 200 CNY applies.

tools.name: create_order
tools.description: Create an order (demo: mock, no payment, no shipment). Requires idempotency_key.

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: Get an order by id (demo: mock).
